passages.note: House roll call 70 (3rd reading) on HJR 3 lists Thompson among the 57 Yea votes, against 40 Nay.

passages.provision_quote: Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: The engrossed resolution's sole operative section defines marriage as only between one man and one woman.

rows.reasoning: Thompson voted Yea in House Roll Call 70 (3rd reading) on HJR 3 (2014), a single-subject joint resolution whose only operative provision states 'Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.' This matches the rung text 'Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman,' foreclosing the recognition that rungs 1–4 call for.
